jobs.name: Veo 3.1 Quality Official
jobs.prompt: Create a photorealistic four-second vertical 9:16 educational presenter video using the supplied photograph as the exact opening frame. Preserve this adult man's identity, hair, stubble, beige overshirt, charcoal shirt, natural skin texture and dark navy studio background. The camera is completely locked: no pan, tilt, zoom, reframing, cuts or transitions. He looks directly at the viewer and speaks exactly this English sentence once: 'Small daily steps lead to lasting change.' Speak in a warm, clear, natural adult male voice, measured but fluent, with no greeting, extra words, repetition, narration or singing. Timing: a brief natural breath at 0.0-0.25 seconds, speak the complete sentence from approximately 0.25 to 3.35 seconds, then close the lips and hold a relaxed friendly expression until the end. Generate the speech naturally as part of this model's native video audio. Mouth, lips, teeth, jaw and cheek movement must synchronize precisely to the spoken phonemes, with believable anatomy. Include subtle breathing and one brief natural blink; avoid head bobs, body sway and large gestures. Soft neutral key light, stable eyes and facial features, natural skin, realistic interview cinematography. Audio is a clean close conversational voice with extremely quiet neutral room tone. No music, echo, other voices, sound effects, captions, subtitles, letters, words, logos, watermarks, diagrams or graphics. COMPOSITION: keep the same normal full-screen presenter framing as the reference, head and upper torso centered prominently in the vertical canvas. Keep his entire head and both shoulders in frame. Do not shrink the presenter toward the bottom in this version.
